sahneler.metin: The earthquake lasted a minute. The fire burned for three days.
It destroyed eighty percent of San Francisco.
So why could nobody put it out?
The quake had shattered the water mains under the streets.
Firefighters opened the hydrants and nothing came out.
Broken gas lines and toppled stoves started hundreds of fires.
Three thousand died and a quarter million lost their homes.
It was the fire, not the quake, that did most of the killing.

aciklama:
In 1906, one of America’s great cities burned for three days. The fire that followed the earthquake caused most of the destruction.
